units.source_text: 衣服都穿旧了，身边又没有侍女，生活实甚寂寞无聊。

en.t: Their clothes had all grown old and worn, and with no ladies-in-waiting around them, life was truly lonely and dull.

units.source_text: 而两女公子都长得如花似玉，做父亲的安得不又怜又爱呢？

en.t: Yet both young ladies were as lovely as flowers and jade; how could their father not cherish and love them all the more?

units.source_text: 他一手执着经卷，一边念诵，一边教女儿唱歌。

en.t: Holding a sutra scroll in one hand, he recited from it while teaching his daughters to sing.

units.source_text: 大女公子学弹琵琶，二女公子学弹筝。

en.t: The elder daughter learned to play the biwa, while the younger learned to play the koto.

units.source_text: 年龄虽然还很幼小，却常练习合奏，弹得都很像样，音节美妙悦耳。

en.t: Although they were still very young, they often practiced playing together, and both played quite well, with beautiful, pleasing tones.
